goal: No project may remain Waiting, Blocked, Frozen, Stale, or Needs Review without an owner, current driving task, escalation path, and review date.

blocked_rule.meaning: A blocked project cannot safely continue until a named unblock action happens.
blocked_rule.required_next_step: Name the blocker, name the owner, resolve or reclassify the blocker, then escalate or archive if no unblock path exists.

heat_rules.cold: Abandoned or inactive without a live path.

aging_rules.blocked_7_days: Escalate or archive unless an owner has an active unblock plan.

studio_changes: Add MIM Command Brief above the Projects table.
Add momentum decay from Waiting to Stale to Needs Review.
Show blocked next-step rule directly in the Waiting On column.
next_action: MIM should use the command brief to choose the next project action instead of letting Waiting or Blocked projects sit silently.
